attacks.name: Teleporting Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|*Ha-HA!|: After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage| and this character is not within |!range| 2 of the defender, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition

attacks.name: Brimstone Blitz
steps: Add dice to this attack equal to the number of times this character has been Placed this Turn.
|!critical| |!hit| |*Flurry of Blows|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional attack action. This attack must target the original defender.

superPowers.name: BAMF!
superPowers.body: This character may spend 1 to 3 |!power| to use this superpower. Place this character within |!range| X of itself, where X is the amount of |!power| spent. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Puff of Smoke
superPowers.body: When this character makes an attack, after that attack is resolved, this character may use this superpower. Place this character within |!range| 2 of the defender.

superPowers.name: Unglaublich Acrobatics
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by a |!physical| or |!energy| attack or would make a dodge roll, it may use this superpower. Add 2 dice to this character's defense or dodge roll.

superPowers.name: Invisible in Shadow
superPowers.body: While this character is within |!range| 1 of a terrain feature of |!size| 2 or more, this character gains the |*Stealth| |!innate| superpower.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side, and from 5 to 7 on Injured side.
The timing for Teleporting Strike was updated to "After this attack is resolved". The Stun special condition now only applies if some |!damage| have been dealt
The timing for Puff of Smoke was updated to "After that attack is resolved"
Invisible in Shadow now grants the Stealth superpower instead of a similar unnamed effect
